blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines – Asean can expect more turbulence and storms ahead in an increasingly uncertain world, but as long as the grouping remains cohesive and united, it can navigate its path forward and emerge stronger, said Prime Minister Lawrence Wong on Nov 15. This will require responding decisively to disruptions by deepening integration, such as through advancing digital integration, strengthening energy security and broadening external partnerships, he added on the first day of the Asean Summit in the Philippines’ capital.
